objective: Repair KL Admin Check / Retry 5 Reading Questions 404 by using active low-cost Gemini Flash-Lite models, make errors actionable, protect manuscript-backed questions and existing BP awards. No standalone OTA.
productionBaselineEvidence: 2026-11-12 production Supabase BUKLOD Connect Edge function kl-generate-reading-quiz v1 returned model HTTP 404 on three admin retries (04:12 UTC) and all six approved released chapter banks were pending with zero generated questions. Current main SHA at PR creation b89848c58ca8f17b9dfcd4dfc7a47bbea869f625. Backend Edge v2 deployed and verified ACTIVE/JWT true, deployed source matches branch. No user-authenticated real-model success yet.
chosenApproach: Retain existing admin-authenticated approved manuscript generation endpoint and secret key. Prefer documented Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite; on explicit model 404 only try 3.1 Flash-Lite; report quota, credentials and validation failures separately to the KL Admin screen. Add Node and read-only SQL security regression contracts.
selectionRationale: Real provider 404, not broken button event. Changing the model is the narrowest fix; no new paid provider or app dependency. Bounded fallback avoids silently multiplying provider cost and preserves exact-evidence validation.
alternativeApproaches: Ignore 404 and keep retrying 2.5 Flash-Lite (rejected: repeatable production failure).
Disable mandatory quiz or weaken source-evidence checks (rejected: undermines fair BP and security).
Use current cost-efficient Flash-Lite with bounded model 404 fallback (selected).
acceptanceChecks: Production Edge function ACTIVE, verify_jwt true, deployed source equals reviewed GitHub source.
System Admin question generation can use available current model with at most one 404 fallback sequence per candidate, no unlimited retry.
Question and answer keys never exposed to anonymous/authenticated Data API; only valid 5-question evidence-checked banks stored.
Admin retry displays explicit provider failures rather than generic pending.
Existing read completion points, chapter approvals/media, comment/reflection, quizzes, offline read, main navigation remain unchanged.
Source-level focused node test and read-only live database security SQL pass.
Real System Admin authenticated model E2E and valid 5-question ready bank remain required before claiming full verification or publishing client OTA.
No Vercel build or standalone Android OTA for this change.
